name: Basilica of the Sacred Heart of Jesus
history: Conewago Chapel was built between 1785 and 1787 in rural Adams County, Pennsylvania. It is the oldest Catholic church built of stone in the United States. Prince Demetrius Gallitzin spent the first years of his priesthood here, 1795 to 1799. It became a basilica in 1962.
arch: Brownstone walls three feet thick, a Federal-style entrance with a semicircular arched doorway, and an 80-foot white spire added in 1873. A three-storey rectory of 1787 is attached.
features: The three-storey rectory attached to it was also built in 1787.
It is part of the Diocese of Harrisburg.

look.d: The arched doorway dates from the 1780s.

fun: Its walls are three feet thick.
journal: Stone walls three feet thick, laid when Washington was still a private citizen.
